name: pixellab_poll
description: Poll a Pixel Lab background job (from pixellab_generate/animate/edit) until it completes, then import its assets into the project. Pass the job_id you were given. When completed, files land under assets/pixellab/ and are listed back to you. Pass wait_seconds to block until done; otherwise it checks once.

job_id.description: The background_job_id returned by a previous Pixel Lab generation.

save_to.description: Override the destination folder slug under assets/pixellab/.

wait_seconds.description: Block and poll up to N seconds (default 0 = single check).
